about: Synthetic test accounts for previews (RELEASE_TEST_PLAN.md, 'Test accounts'). petDaysAgo: Timmy Tooth was adopted that many days ago (sh_pet_born), so he shows on the hubs as he does for a student who adopted him; the new learner has not adopted him. Every id, name and number here is made up: none is copied or derived from a real student, visitor id, answer, report or comment. Never paste production rows into this file (the repo is public). Answers are generated in the browser from each hub's own question ids, with a fixed seed, so every tester sees the same history.

personas.name: New learner
personas.summary: First visit: no saved progress, no name yet, the guided tour shows, every count starts at zero.

personas.name: Returning learner
personas.summary: Studied the live hubs on and off for a week: about 45% of questions tried, 72% right, a few pins, a reply waiting in the Inbox, a survey to answer.

inbox.note: The second choice on this question looks the same as the third. (fixture report)
inbox.message: Thanks! The two choices now differ, and the explanation says why. (fixture reply)

personas.name: High-XP learner
personas.summary: Top of the rank board: Dark Matter, a long daily streak, most questions answered, trophies (Full Arch among them: on the redesign it shows as retired) and mastery badges.

personas.name: Missed-question learner
personas.summary: Lots of misses: about half the questions tried and 38% right, so Weak Spots, the Daily Drill, Questions I missed and Find this in the notes all have plenty to show.

personas.name: Archived-hub learner
personas.summary: Studied only hubs whose exams are over (Heme & Endo, MSK 3 and 4, PCD Exam 3). Pair it with Time travel to the night after an exam to see archiving, the archived notice and the check-in pop-up.

personas.name: Admin
personas.summary: Sam's role: a returning learner whose admin page (review/) opens with the preview's admin secret, with fixture reports, suggestions, surveys and podcast comments to resolve, hide and answer. The real admin secret is never typed into a preview.
